verdict: Main campaign is paused and spend has collapsed to near zero, stalling lead flow this period.
diagnosis: Only 2 leads generated on $7,221 spend over 28 days, with the primary call campaign sitting in PAUSED status.

signals.headline: Only 2 leads in 28 days
signals.detail: Lead volume is critically low. The paused call campaign is the likely cause of the drop-off.

signals.headline: Spend totaled $7,221 this period
signals.detail: Money is still flowing but producing almost no leads. Cost per lead landed at roughly $3,610.

signals.headline: 9 purchases worth $5,897
signals.detail: E-commerce side is working, delivering roughly $5 back for every $1 spent on tracked purchases.

signals.headline: 220 direction requests, 1 call
signals.detail: Google Business Profile drives map interest but almost no phone calls, a weak signal for a life-alert buyer.

signals.headline: Click-through rate at 5%
signals.detail: Clicks are healthy when ads do run. The problem is volume, not creative or targeting quality.

recommendations.title: Reactivate the paused call campaign immediately
recommendations.detail: The BWS Search Call Campaign is sitting in PAUSED status. Consider turning it back on before Q4 gift-buying demand fades after December.

recommendations.title: Shift budget toward the purchase funnel
recommendations.detail: Purchases returned roughly 5x on spend this period. Worth testing more budget into e-commerce ads while lead campaigns are rebuilt.

recommendations.title: Fix phone tracking on Google Business Profile
recommendations.detail: Only 1 call click against 220 direction requests looks like a tracking gap. Test a dedicated call extension and verify phone conversions fire.
